separately_gated_future_phases.name: IDENTITY_AND_DEPENDENCY_PREFLIGHT
checks: Resolve exact tokenizer assets and require byte identities matching the approved identity.
Record tokenizer library, implementation, platform, decoder, cleanup, and normalization identities.
Stop before inventory on any mismatch or unresolved dependency.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: TOKENIZER_INVENTORY
checks: Enumerate vocabulary, BOS, EOS, PAD, UNK, added, special, and control tokens.
Classify empty, invalid, replacement-character, cleanup-sensitive, and control-bearing decodings.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: STANDALONE_DECODE_MAP
checks: Decode every token without model loading or generation.
Record collisions and byte/Unicode behavior without treating standalone pieces as compositional proof.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: CONTEXTUAL_COMPOSITIONALITY_MATRIX
checks: Compare decode(prefix plus token) with decode(prefix) across representative states of both Phase 2 lanes.
Include literal, enum, JSON string, escape, Unicode, source hash, numeric boundary, finding-link, decisive-finding, and terminal states.
Classify stable suffix, prior-text rewrite, incomplete-byte completion, and cleanup-sensitive behavior.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: REQUEST_BOUND_REFERENCE_AND_GRAPH_STRESS
checks: Cover shortest and longest legal UTF-8 coordinates, shared decimal prefixes, source hashes, and illegal cross-boundary values.
Cover sequential finding IDs, variable finding counts, and the forced final decisive transition.
Compare every result with fresh character-controller rebuild.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: FULL_VOCABULARY_ONE_STEP_ADMISSION
checks: At a bounded representative matrix, compare all token decisions with the prefix-sensitive full-decode oracle.
Verify EOS only at terminal and exclude all other special tokens.
Record character-live but token-dead states distinctly.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: STRATEGY_EQUIVALENCE_DECISION
checks: Compare allowed-token-set hashes for context-free, mixed, and oracle strategies.
Authorize no optimization class unless false acceptance and false rejection are both zero.
Select full decode for every unproven class.

separately_gated_future_phases.name: ZERO_INFERENCE_RESOURCE_CHARACTERIZATION
checks: Measure deterministic latency, memory, rebuild cost, and cache isolation without model loading.
Recommend a strategy only; do not implement or bind a projector.

stop_conditions: Any decoding class cannot be compared exactly with the full-decode oracle.
Any false acceptance, EOS leak, special-token leak, or cache isolation failure.
Any requirement for model loading, generation, evaluator/runner binding, application authority, or probe construction.
recommended_separately_authorized_next_s: Owner-review and freeze the design and plan. If approved, load only the identity-bound tokenizer and execute Phases 0-7 as a zero-inference compatibility audit, stopping before projector implementation.
